    "Model forecasts are consistently too low in early periods, showing significant lag that gets corrected as history extends",
    "True outcomes show more volatility than model forecasts, especially in the first 10-15 day horizon",
    "Sentiment positivity (value >= 0.67) correlates with above-model outcomes, especially in short-term",
    "Model mean reverts to center of history faster than actual prices, causing undershoot on trends",
    "Major price inflections in true outcomes (like the 81+ range shifts) aren't captured by model until after the fact",
    "Sentiment turning positive (0.67+ after periods of 0.33 or less) predicts 0.5-1.5 euro/day faster recovery than model indicates",
    "Model lacks momentum capture - true prices maintain trends longer than model mean-reverting forecasts suggest"
] }
